meta.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

copy.tagline: 在会话中并行执行独立子任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在当前会话中同时推进多个独立实现任务
copy.tagline_en: Execute independent subtasks in parallel within the session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run multiple independent implementation tasks concurrently in the current session

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为每个独立任务创建一个全新的子代理来执行，并在每个任务完成后进行规范合规性和代码质量审查，最后对整个分支进行广泛审查。
howto.when: 当你有实现计划且任务大部分独立，并在当前会话中执行时触发。

say.text: 请按计划执行任务1，使用快速模型。
say.note: Claude 会为任务1创建子代理并执行。
Claude 会派发任务审查子代理进行审查。
Claude 会派发最终代码审查子代理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates a fresh subagent per independent task, performs a task review (spec compliance + code quality) after each, and a broad whole-branch review at the end.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have an implementation plan with mostly independent tasks and stay in the current session.

say_en.text: Execute task 1 using a cheap model.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches a subagent for task 1.

say_en.text: Review the diff file for task 2.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches a task reviewer subagent.
Claude dispatches the final code reviewer subagent.
